leads.name: Oliveira Real of Pedras d'el Rei, Tavira (access still unsettled)

location.address: Aldeamento Turistico de Pedras d'el Rei, Santa Luzia

leads.reason: access: inside holiday resort; Postal do Algarve, Barlavento, Komoot highlight 7311777 (public Highlight, coords 37.095941,-7.678019, says nothing about entry) and resort material never say non-guests may enter. Confirmed pin and Commons photo exist (see data/research/faro-verified.json tav_001). Possible new evidence: Tavira municipal route 'Os segredos e encantos da Ria Formosa' (visitartavira.pt PDF) lists an 'Oliveira bimilenaria (a esquerda)' next to the Santa Luzia parish church; ICNF has only one Tavira tree (KNJ1/195), so it is either the same tree loosely placed or an unregistered second olive. Needs a human read of the route map page before it counts as a public-access source.

Unresolved; do not publish a second entry.
